caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with two main sections, rendered in shades of brown to suggest a natural wood color. The upper section features two cabinet doors with pointed arch designs and a pair of metal handles, set above vertical wooden panels that form a backing. The lower section has a flat countertop, four drawers with round knobs on the left side, and two additional cabinet doors with matching pointed arch details and metal handles on the right side. The wood grain is visible throughout, and the piece stands on four legs. The background is plain and a signature reading "Elmer P. Kottcamp" is visible in the lower right corner. There are faint brownish marks at the top of the image.
title: Sink Bench
